info.name: Kipa - Support Chat & Admin Auth API
info.description:
Support Chat System and Admin Authentication for Kipa Platform

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1

## Overview
User-to-admin support chat system plus admin signup flow.

## Support Chat Features
- **One conversation per user** - Only one open conversation at a time
- **Any admin can reply** - No assignment required
- **Active disputes shown** - When user opens support, their open/under_review disputes are surfaced with full details
- **Push notifications** - Admins notified on new user messages, users notified on admin replies
- **Media support** - Text and image messages supported

## User Support Flow
1. User calls `GET /support` to open/resume conversation
2. Response includes conversation + any active disputes with evidence
3. User sends messages via `POST /support/messages`
4. User fetches history via `GET /support/messages`
5. User marks messages read via `POST /support/messages/read`

## Admin Support Flow
1. Admin lists conversations via `GET /admin/support/conversations`
2. Admin views conversation details via `GET /admin/support/conversations/:id`
3. Admin replies via `POST /admin/support/conversations/:id/messages`
4. Admin resolves conversation via `POST /admin/support/conversations/:id/resolve`

## Admin Signup Flow
1. Send OTP via `POST /auth/otp/send` (same as regular users)
2. Verify with admin secret via `POST /auth/admin/otp/verify`
3. User becomes admin (is_admin: true)

## Variables
- `base_url`: API base URL (e.g., http://localhost:8080)
- `access_token`: JWT access token
- `conversation_id`: Support conversation ID
- `admin_secret`: Server-configured admin signup secret
- `verification_id`: OTP verification ID

item.name: User - Support Chat
item.description: Endpoints for users to contact admin support.

request.description:
Get existing open conversation or create a new one.

Also returns any active disputes (status: open or under_review) for the user with full details including escrow and payment request info.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "conversation": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "user_id": "uuid",
    "user_name": "John Doe",
    "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
    "status": "open",
    "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
    "unread_count": 2,
    "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
  },
  "active_disputes": [
    {
      "dispute": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "escrow_id": "uuid",
        "opened_by": "uuid",
        "reason": "Item not as described",
        "evidence": ["https://s3.../image1.jpg", "https://s3.../image2.jpg"],
        "status": "open",
        "outcome": "pending",
        "created_at": "2025-01-14T10:00:00Z"
      },
      "escrow": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "payment_request_id": "uuid",
        "buyer_id": "uuid",
        "seller_id": "uuid",
        "item_amount": 50000,
        "buyer_fee": 750,
        "delivery_fee_estimate": 2000,
        "total_locked": 52750,
        "status": "disputed"
      },
      "payment_request": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "seller_id": "uuid",
        "buyer_id": "uuid",
        "payment_code": "KIP-ABC123",
        "item_name": "iPhone 15 Pro",
        "item_description": "256GB Space Black",
        "item_price": 50000,
        "status": "disputed"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Send a message in the user's open support conversation.

**Request Body:**
- `content` (required): Message text (1-2000 characters)
- `media_url` (optional): URL to uploaded media
- `media_type` (optional): `text` or `image` (default: text)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "uuid",
  "sender_id": "uuid",
  "sender_name": "John Doe",
  "is_admin": false,
  "content": "Hello, I need help with my order",
  "media_url": null,
  "media_type": "text",
  "status": "sent",
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
  "read_at": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- Admins are notified via push notification
- User must have an open conversation first (call GET /support)

Send an image message. Upload the image first using the upload endpoint, then include the URL here.

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "content": "Here is a screenshot of the issue",
  "media_url": "https://s3.../image.jpg",
  "media_type": "image"
}
```

query.description: Number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 100)
Fetch messages before this message ID (for pagination)

request.description:
Get message history for the user's open conversation.

**Query Parameters:**
- `limit` (optional): Number of messages (default: 50, max: 100)
- `before_id` (optional): Message ID for pagination (fetch older messages)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "conversation_id": "uuid",
      "sender_id": "uuid",
      "sender_name": "Support",
      "is_admin": true,
      "content": "How can I help you today?",
      "media_url": null,
      "media_type": "text",
      "status": "read",
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
      "read_at": "2025-01-15T10:06:00Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "conversation_id": "uuid",
      "sender_id": "uuid",
      "sender_name": "John Doe",
      "is_admin": false,
      "content": "Hello, I need help with my order",
      "media_url": null,
      "media_type": "text",
      "status": "sent",
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "read_at": null
    }
  ]
}
```

**Notes:**
- Messages are returned in descending order (newest first)
- Use `before_id` to load older messages

Mark all admin messages as read in the user's conversation.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Only marks admin messages as read (not user's own messages)
- Call this when user opens the chat screen

item.name: Admin - Support Chat
item.description:
Admin endpoints for managing support conversations.

Requires admin privileges.

query.description: Filter by status: open, resolved, closed

request.description:
List all support conversations.

**Query Parameters:**
- `status` (optional): Filter by status (`open`, `resolved`, `closed`)
- `limit` (optional): Number of results (default: 50)
- `offset` (optional): Pagination offset (default: 0)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "user_id": "uuid",
      "user_name": "John Doe",
      "user_phone": "+2348012345678",
      "status": "open",
      "last_message_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "unread_count": 3,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 15
}
```

**Notes:**
- Sorted by last_message_at descending
- `unread_count` shows user messages not read by admin

Get message history for a specific conversation.

**Query Parameters:**
- `limit` (optional): Number of messages (default: 50, max: 100)
- `before_id` (optional): Message ID for pagination

**Response:**
```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "conversation_id": "uuid",
      "sender_id": "uuid",
      "sender_name": "John Doe",
      "is_admin": false,
      "content": "Hello, I need help",
      "media_url": null,
      "media_type": "text",
      "status": "sent",
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "read_at": null
    }
  ]
}
```

Send a reply to a user's conversation.

**Request Body:**
- `content` (required): Message text (1-2000 characters)
- `media_url` (optional): URL to uploaded media
- `media_type` (optional): `text` or `image`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "uuid",
  "sender_id": "uuid",
  "sender_name": "Admin Name",
  "is_admin": true,
  "content": "Hello! I can help you with that.",
  "media_url": null,
  "media_type": "text",
  "status": "sent",
  "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
  "read_at": null
}
```

**Notes:**
- User receives push notification
- Any admin can reply to any conversation

Mark all user messages as read in a conversation.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Only marks user messages as read (not admin messages)
- Call this when admin opens the conversation

Mark a conversation as resolved.

Once resolved, the user will get a new conversation if they contact support again.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "message": "conversation resolved successfully"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Changes status from `open` to `resolved`
- User can start a new conversation if needed

item.name: Admin Auth
item.description:
Admin signup flow. Uses same OTP send endpoint as regular users, but verifies with admin secret.

**Flow:**
1. Send OTP to phone number (same as regular users)
2. Verify OTP with admin secret - creates/upgrades user to admin

**Configuration:**
Server must have `server.admin_signup_secret` configured.

request.description:
Send OTP to phone number. Same endpoint as regular users.

**Request Body:**
- `phone_number` (required): Phone in E.164 format (e.g., +2348012345678)
- `device_id` (required): Unique device identifier (8-128 chars)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "verification_id": "uuid",
    "idempotency_key": "string",
    "expires_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
    "retry_after_seconds": 60
  }
}
```

Verify OTP with admin secret. Creates new admin user or upgrades existing user to admin.

**Request Body:**
- `phone_number` (required): Phone in E.164 format
- `verification_id` (required): From send OTP response
- `otp_code` (required): 6-digit OTP
- `device_id` (required): Same device ID from send OTP
- `idempotency_key` (required): Unique key (32-64 chars)
- `admin_secret` (required): Server-configured admin secret (min 16 chars)

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJ...",
    "expires_in": 900,
    "token_type": "Bearer",
    "user": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "phone_number": "+2348012345678",
      "phone_verified": true,
      "is_admin": true,
      "is_seller": false,
      "is_buyer": false,
      "is_rider": false,
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z"
    },
    "is_new_user": true
  }
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `401 INVALID_ADMIN_SECRET`: Wrong admin secret
- `403 ADMIN_SIGNUP_NOT_ALLOWED`: Admin signup not configured on server
- `401 INVALID_OTP`: Wrong OTP code
- `401 OTP_EXPIRED`: OTP has expired
